items.description: Historic Brazzaville City Hall is one of the capital's key administrative buildings. It reflects the city's colonial and civic heritage.
Ngabé Historic Center preserves the memory of an old river settlement in the Pool area. It is part of the region's longer settlement history.
The Old Court of Brazzaville is a former judicial building in the capital. It stands as a reminder of the city's administrative past.
Historic Fort-Rousset Core marks the older colonial center of today's Owando. The name preserves the town's earlier identity as Fort-Rousset.
Kindamba Mission Station records the presence of early missionary activity in the Pool region. It is part of the area's local religious heritage.
Independence Bridge is a major bridge in Brazzaville with civic and symbolic value. It is associated with the capital's modern urban development.
